**New: Threat Monitor is now a macOS screensaver too.** Created and maintained by Oliver Kuy.

### Downloads

| Download | For | How to install |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows screensaver (ZIP)** | Windows 10 and 11 | Unzip, double-click `install.bat`. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click *More info → Run anyway*. |
| **macOS screensaver (ZIP)** | macOS 12 Monterey or later, Apple silicon and Intel | Open the zip, double-click **Threat Monitor.saver**, click *Install*. If macOS says it can't verify it, open *System Settings → Privacy & Security* and click **Open Anyway** (once). |

Mac users can also install from Terminal with no security prompts:
`curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kuydigital/threat_monitor/main/mac/install.sh | bash`

### What's new
- **Native macOS screensaver**, written in Swift: same news sources, scoring and screens as the Windows and Raspberry Pi versions. Works on every display, drifts slowly to protect the screen, updates every 15 minutes and starts instantly with the last values. Automated tests check it gives exactly the same scores and headlines as the Python version on the same news.
- WAR no longer counts crime stories about "home invasions".
- Python version: **F** switches between a window and full screen.

Data: BBC, Al Jazeera, NPR, Google News, GDACS, USGS, CISA, WHO. It measures how much is being reported, not real-world danger.
